select * from chat_message where room_id = #{room_id} order by message_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into chat_message (message_id, room_id, sender_id, content, created_at, read_count) values (message_seq.nextval,#{room_id},#{sender_id},#{content},sysdate, 1)
mapper.select: select * from chat_message where room_id = #{room_id} order by message_id asc

SELECT r.room_id, r.room_name,
lm.content AS last_message, lm.created_at AS last_time,
NVL(uc.unread_count, 0) AS unread_count FROM chat_room r JOIN chat_room_user ru ON r.room_id = ru.room_id
-- ✅ 방별 마지막 메시지 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, content, created_at FROM ( SELECT room_id, content, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY room_id ORDER BY message_id DESC ) rn FROM chat_message ) WHERE rn = 1 ) lm ON lm.room_id = r.room_id
-- ✅ 방별 안 읽은 메시지 수 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT room_id, COUNT(*) AS unread_count FROM chat_message WHERE sender_id != #{userId} AND read_count = 1 GROUP BY room_id ) uc ON uc.room_id = r.room_id
WHERE ru.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY lm.created_at DESC NULLS LAST
